reason: The free version already gives me 3 typed questions a day, which is more than I'd ever ask while cooking a 10-15 minute dish a few times a week. If I'm really stuck I just ask ChatGPT for free, so I'm not paying 99 baht a month just to ask more questions.
objection: A free AI chat already answers my cooking questions, so paying only for unlimited questions makes no sense to me. And the only two dishes are a fried egg and a kai jeow, which I think of as oily food, not how I cook to eat healthy.
would_change_my_mind: If the membership gave me lots of lighter Thai recipes with calories, oil and salt shown per serving, not just more questions.
